high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a mobile device displaying search results from a web browser. The top of the screen shows the time as 2:18, along with various status icons such as Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, airplane mode, and battery level at 20%. Below these icons, there is a section titled "Flashback 1980" with a link to "More results." The main content of the image is a search result for the question "Who ruled India in 1988?" The result provides information about the Rajiv Gandhi Ministry, which was the government that ruled India during that period. Key
